text: And here's the twist. This isn't really the future. In Delhi, a woman today has, on average... one point two children. In Japan, it's about the same. (beat) Delhi... already has Japan's family size. And Kerala and Tamil Nadu aren't far behind. The shrinking India we just imagined... already exists. In our own cities. We just haven't noticed.
